modalLead: A new install starts better, and the quiet features are easier to find: a Quick start that asks first, tours for the keyboard, Monitoring and Unraid, and four short offers. Analytics sends less.

items.text: The Quick start asks before it does. Keep the example links or start with an empty page, then pick a ready-made page (Homelab, Media server, Developer) that goes beside them or onto the empty one. Ten steps, three at a time; Show more for the rest.
Import a CSV file from the guide, or choose On a new page when you import bookmarks from a file in Config → Data & backups.
An example tag cloud. Browse by tag shows made-up tags once if you have none yet, then points to the Tags view.
A keyboard tour. Four steps on typing, : commands, ? finders and the single keys. Start it from the search panel, with :tour keyboard or from Config → Help → Guided tours.
Tours for Config → Monitoring and Config → Unraid, with a Tour button on each, and a mouse step in the dashboard tour.
Tips can come weekly, and a switch turns off the first-visit tours: Config → Behavior → Onboarding.
Settings search remembers. An empty search lists the settings you opened or changed last.
Four short offers, each with its own switch. Check images for updates (Containers), re-check old links (Bookmarks view), the browser extension (Inbox) and what changed after an update.
Find tags for one category from its menu.
The action bar and the command palette take more of your theme and stand apart from the cards with an edge and a shadow. A button that is on is filled.
The title no longer runs into the buttons at the top of Config, and the band is the same height on every tab.

Privacy-friendly analytics counts an install once. A random install code, made on your server, lets visits from one install count as one. It follows the same switch, so there is no new question, and it is not sent when analytics is off.
The address you open nextDash on is no longer sent. It is replaced by one word: lan, domain or localhost. The page you came from and the page title stay home too.
Your settings are sent less often. When they change, once a month and at most once a week, instead of on every page load. What is recorded? under Behavior → Privacy & sync lists the details.
